title: tests/kernel/test_akcipher.c: in-kernel tests for RSA
description: Kernel module testing the RSA akcipher registration. Tests: (1) RSA-2048 sign a known message hash with a test private key (from tests/vectors/rsa.h), verify the signature with the corresponding public key; (2) RSA-2048 public encrypt, private decrypt roundtrip; (3) tampered signature (flip one byte) must return an error from verify; (4) verify that .max_size returns 256 for RSA-2048. Print pass/fail per check.
design: Use crypto_alloc_akcipher(). Key loading: akcipher_request_set_crypt with DER-encoded key bytes. .set_pub_key / .set_priv_key are called via crypto_akcipher_set_pub_key / crypto_akcipher_set_priv_key. The test DER keys must come from tests/vectors/rsa.h — generated with OpenSSL and hardcoded, never generated at test runtime. See tests/vectors/rsa.h.
acceptance_criteria: Sign+verify roundtrip passes. Tampered signature returns error. .max_size == 256 for RSA-2048. Module loads and unloads cleanly.
close_reason: All 5 RSA tests implemented in test_akcipher.c: sign KAT, verify KAT, tamper rejection, encrypt+decrypt roundtrip, maxsize check. Uses crypto_sig API for pkcs1(rsa,sha256) and crypto_akcipher for raw RSA. Vectors in rsa.h.
